researchers.title: Airbnb / Booking arbitrage — Skopje
researchers.description: Find flats offered for long-term rent where the rent is low for the spot, and estimate what the same flat would earn on Airbnb / Booking.

researchers.title: Land for a house / villa
researchers.description: Skopje and Ohrid plots, plus plots anywhere in mountain areas. Electricity, water and road access must be confirmed in the ad.

researchers.title: Fix & flip — under market value
researchers.description: Flats and houses priced well under the local median €/m², with an estimate of renovation, transaction costs and the resulting profit / ROI.

researchers.title: Motivated sellers — negotiation targets
researchers.description: Sellers who have cut their price, use "urgent" language, or have been sitting on the market for weeks. These are the ads where an offer well under asking has a real chance — across every property type.
